_seed_doc: Golden seed corpus: SOCIAL/INVESTIGATION archetype. Pure dialogue scene at a checkpoint, no combat. DM spawns 2-3 NPCs across faction Lines so the MCP naming pipeline is well-exercised.
session_name: CHECKPOINT PASSAGE DEMO — Meridian Gate standing gate (VIII.1)
scenario_hint: Meridian Gate — a Sovereign Nexus checkpoint between Freeborn territory and the Nexus-administered trade rings. The two couriers must pass through the gate to deliver their shipment. The gate reads each traveler's Codex standing (Soulcredit). Lawful passage is simply presenting your standing and walking through — IF your standing clears. For someone Cut Off, the lawful path is closed and only alternate approaches remain: bribe a guard, deceive the auditor, slip the cordon, or turn back. An honest off-ramp always exists (turn back / declare and accept seizure), so the log captures a CHOSEN path, not a forced one. To attempt passage, a courier declares an EXPLORE action with checkpoint_id set to the gate's ID.

players.name: Courier Vale Orne
goals: Reach the Nexus trade ring despite a fouled ledger
Get the shipment through Meridian Gate

players.name: Courier Rell Dane
goals: Get the shipment through Meridian Gate

notes: Checkpoint passage demo. Vale (SC -3) is denied lawful passage and must choose an alternate path; Rell (SC +2) clears. Enforce mode judges whatever Vale chooses.
_design_notes: Passage-focused demo for the VIII.1 checkpoint gate. Two Freeborn couriers must pass Meridian Gate (Sovereign Nexus, reads the ledger). Vale is Cut-Off-adjacent (SC -3) and will be DENIED lawful passage; Rell (SC +2) clears. Denied, Vale must choose an alternate path (bribe/deceive/sneak) — which enforce-mode then judges, tightening the spiral. Players are told to declare an EXPLORE action with checkpoint_id to attempt passage.
